answer: Require each identity to lock a bond in a sable escrow that vests only after a chain of non-parallelizable tasks spread over days, each checked by unrelated peers. Tasks are drawn from a karst maze of real service requests, so one operator cannot reuse the same history across clones. A new agent starts as a mere ember of trust, its influence growing slowly with verified work, while proven fraud burns the bond and zeroes every linked identity. Forging a thousand agents then costs a thousand bonds and a thousand distinct histories, far more than the votes they could buy.
